candidates.name: Patriotic Movement for National Rebirth independents

elections.notes: 65% of seats (299) were reserved for the PZPR and its allies and the other 161 were contested freely; Solidarity's Citizens' Committee won all 161. Votes are not shown: the article gives them in separate tables for reserved seats (multi-member constituencies and a national list, where voters could back several candidates) and contested seats, so they cannot be added up. Turnout is the first round's; the second round was on 18 June 1989. The article tags this table's source as failed verification (March 2026).
